title: AP2 mandates inside a UCP checkout (spec flow; live use unverified)
summary: When dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate is in the intersection, the session is security locked. The business signs every checkout response (ap2.merchant_authorization, a detached JWS over the JCS-canonical checkout). The platform verifies it before showing the checkout, and on complete sends ap2.checkout_mandate (an SD-JWT with key binding that contains the whole signed checkout) plus a payment mandate inside the credential token. No public source shows this running in production as of 2026-10-11.

steps.label: POST /checkout-sessions (profile lists AP2, keys)
steps.detail: Both profiles list dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate, which extends checkout; the business config declares vp_formats_supported with dc+sd-jwt. Under the trusted platform provider model, the platform profile must publish at least one key in keys.

failures.condition: The platform profile has no usable key

steps.label: Intersection includes AP2: lock the session
steps.detail: From now on neither party may fall back to an unprotected checkout for this session.

steps.label: Checkout + ap2.merchant_authorization
steps.detail: The business signs the checkout without the ap2 field, canonicalized with JCS, as a JWS with detached content (header..signature). The header names alg (ES256, ES384 or ES512) and kid.

failures.outcome: merchant_authorization_missing or merchant_authorization_invalid; the platform must not show the checkout.

steps.label: Verify, show, get consent
steps.detail: The platform verifies the business signature with a key from the business keys array, then shows the checkout. A trusted platform provider signs mandates with its server key after explicit consent; alternatively the user wallet signs with a key bound to a digital payment credential, for example through OpenID4VP.

steps.label: complete with ap2.checkout_mandate
steps.detail: The checkout mandate is an SD-JWT with key binding that contains the full checkout, including the business signature, so the platform signature covers it. The payment mandate travels in payment.instruments[*].credential.token.

failures.outcome: mandate_required; the business must reject the complete.

failures.condition: Mandate bound to another checkout, expired or badly signed

steps.label: Verify mandate; pass payment mandate to PSP
steps.detail: The business verifies the checkout mandate and keeps it as durable evidence; the PSP verifies the payment mandate in the credential.

steps.label: completed with order
steps.detail: Same completion as the main flow.
